evidence_items.publisher: Junquan Deng, Zhiyu Fan and Ruijie Meng / arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Section 7, discussion of the awareness–action gap
evidence_items.explanation: The study reports vulnerabilities in 91% of 200 audited deployed applications and investigates recurring agent failure mechanisms. It supports the security-risk component, but does not establish that this workflow caused the rise in infrastructure failures described by Marcus.

evidence_items.publisher: Songwen Zhao and colleagues / ICML 2026, arXiv version
evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark finds a large gap between functional and secure solutions. Its tasks were selected from cases where human programmers also produced vulnerable implementations, so it does not by itself establish a general causal disadvantage or realized infrastructure damage.

unresolved_gaps: The studies establish security defects and plausible mechanisms, but not the claimed contribution to rising serious failures.
The cited benchmark is not a representative comparison against ordinary human development.
